title: Training Notes on the Plan-Age Credit for Re-Spread Patient Payment Plans Installments
content:
Patient Services Center training notes on the credit a re-spread installment of a Patient Payment Plans plan carries for the age of the agreement.

**Q. What is the plan-age credit?**
A. The plan-age credit on the re-spread installment is 2.00 when the agreement was signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date, 1.00 when it was signed at least 6 but fewer than 12 whole months before, and 0.00 otherwise.

**Q. How is it applied?**
A. The credit is subtracted from the spread of the plan balance; the re-spread installment is never below the tier's minimum installment and is rounded half up to the cent.

**Q. Which record decides it?**
A. The signing date of the agreement, counted in whole months up to the handling date.

| Agreement signed, before the handling date | Plan-age credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 12 whole months or more | 2.00 |
| 6 to 11 whole months | 1.00 |
| Fewer than 6 whole months | 0.00 |

**Q. Where are the edges? (hypothetical dates)**
A. Signed 20 March 2025: on 20 March 2026 the agreement is 12 whole months old and the credit is 2.00; on 19 March 2026 it is 11 whole months old and the credit is 1.00. Signed 20 September 2025: on 20 March 2026 it is 6 whole months old, 1.00; on 19 March 2026 it is 5, 0.00.
